1. Nathan Dantzler (Music Mastering Engineer)
If you are looking up a song or album credit, Nathan Dantzler is the Grammy-nominated mastering engineer who mastered the 2026 dark-pop track "Vantablack" by British singer-songwriter Maisy Kay. 
2. Nathan Bulla (Progressive Metal Drummer)
If your interest stems from modern progressive instrumental metal, Nathan Bulla is the talented session and touring drummer featured on the heavy, groove-driven track titled "VANTABLACK" by the Canadian band Intervals (spearheaded by guitarist Aaron Marshall) from their 2020 album Circadian. 
What is the original Vantablack?
Outside of music creators, Vantablack itself is a world-famous nanotechnology material developed by Surrey NanoSystems. It is comprised of a "forest" of vertically aligned carbon nanotubes that trap 99.965% of visible light, making 3D objects coated in it look like a flat, two-dimensional void or black hole. It sparked immense mainstream notoriety when contemporary artist Anish Kapoor purchased exclusive artistic rights to the material, legally barring all other artists from using it.
